_: The style a skilled digitizer would pick for each corpus picture, with the reason, written by looking at the pictures before the chooser (artcheck.js `chooseStyle`) was built. `also`: a style a person could defend too. The chooser's agreement is counted on `style`; see docs/pictures.md 'Style chosen per picture'.
